original_policy.note: Lateral/overlap/perimeter are declared trial policies, not physical laws. Explicit lateral/overlap values permit a bounded contact experiment, not a material-feasibility claim. The initial COM search radius does not change the 30 mm individual or 50 mm cumulative correction budget. The 5 mm minimum teddy/left-robot clearance is an engineering preflight allowance, not a physical law. Bottom clearance and lateral trial fraction are configurable; no compression is prescribed.

whole_tetra_left_sweep.model_scope: continuous frozen tetrahedral body versus MuJoCo convex collision solids
limitations: Does not predict deformation, friction, grasp retention or contact forces.
Robot convex envelopes can overestimate nonconvex native collision surfaces.
Left pose is fixed at measured q; native affine compliance and future tracking are not included.
Only the declared straight translation segment is certified; other segments and obstacles require separate gates.
The certificate is for frozen-shape Cartesian translation, not continuous FK tracking of an interpolated joint trajectory.
A fresh actual-shape check remains necessary after physical preparation.

Changing the base is not simulated or executable from the old joint state. A fresh native run must validate every initial phase and grasp.
New-base source q is solved for the original actual TCP and full rotation; this is an explicit frozen hypothetical robot arrangement, not a saved actual state.
All soft points, left measured q and both individual finger positions are frozen. Native forces, deformation, slip and evolving cloth are not predicted.

The 5mm sweep covers every frozen tetrahedron along ideal straight Cartesian translation against original MuJoCo convex left collision solids. It is not a continuous joint-FK error or native contact certificate.
Robot clearances and Cartesian FK are 401 sampled checks. Joint limits and conservative velocity/acceleration bounds cover the continuous reference curve.
10mm above every cloth vertex certifies only the frozen high traverse. Descent through actual cloth/body/straps and whole final containment remain unproved.
